newsitem.title: UK: London's OMLX sets up clearance link with SOM.
newsitem.headline: London's OMLX sets up clearance link with SOM.

text.p: OMLX, the London securities and derivatives exchange, said it had begun a clearing link with SOM Ltd. of Finland. It said a cooperation link between SOM and OM Stockholm begun in June 1995 would be extended to include OMLX.

"The OMLX exchange will list Finnish FRAs and Finnish government bond futures which accord with SOM's product specifications," OMLX said in a statement released late on Thursday. The link was made effective as of Thursday.
"This will allow a member of the OMLX exchange to trade these products with members of SOM, the OMLX exchange or OM Stockholm and to clear the contracts through the OMLX exchange."
